payload.name: Conspicuous Consumption
payload.fact: Religiosity can function as a form of status signaling, termed 'conspicuous consumption of piousness', where religious identity is displayed as a marker of piety and modernity.
payload.boundary: Human social perception and mating strategies

provenance.quote_or_locus: In this context, religiosity emerges as a unique form of status signaling, referred to in this study as "conspicuous consumption of piousness

provenance.title: Peacocks, Porsches, and Thorstein Veblen: Conspicuous consumption as a sexual signaling system.
provenance.quote_or_locus: A fourth experiment showed that observers interpret such signals accurately, with women perceiving men who conspicuously consume as being interested in short-term mating

provenance.title: Peacocks, Porsches, and Thorstein Veblen: Conspicuous consumption as a sexual signaling system.
provenance.quote_or_locus: Three experiments demonstrated that conspicuous consumption is driven by men who are following a lower investment (vs. higher investment) mating strategy and is triggered specifically by short-term (vs. long-term) mating motives

decision_note: NOT_TRANSFERABLE — rejected as a batch because the corpus concentration, not any one claim, is the finding: 3 of these 11 proposals cite the SAME single source (10.1002/cb.70189, smartphone battery depletion) and 3 more cite ANOTHER single source (10.1086/673256, luxury handbag signaling) — 6 of 11 are near-duplicate readings of two papers. This is a corpus coverage defect, not a per-claim transferability judgment; logged separately that ST-09 needs re-harvest, not further review, before its next batch.
